title: Reject refresh credentials at the shared access-token verifier
scope: Contain F02 refresh-as-access by rejecting signed refresh payloads after verification and before protected dispatch, preserving current access/tool/SDK compatibility. Only the narrow W02 guard and its focused proof, not full identity/session/readiness/abuse policy.
non_goals: No token issuer/service migration, mandatory claim/session/tenant policy, SSO/onboarding/abuse/readiness or customer decision.
No deployment, external egress, real credentials/data, install/seed/cloud/git mutation or unrelated code/config/bundle edits.
No full W02/finding/gate/customer/SLO/release closure; preserve and separately revalidate affected W01.02 proof.

criteria.description: Real login-issued fresh and revoked refresh bearers are refused before protected auth/config effects; concrete before-state read/mutation and body/revision/index baseline distinguishes fix from fixture failure.

Real access and untyped tool credentials plus existing access/service token shapes retain successful reads/writes; renewal/logout and normal invalid/optional/role/permission behavior hold. Real SDK/operator middleware denies refresh delegation with independent SDK-key controls.

Independent frozen source/test/evidence review, targeted regressions/typechecks, scope limits and actual lead handoff establish narrow remedy without hiding remaining W02 obligations or stale W01.02 evidence.

checks.runtime: Node v22.15.0/Vitest with real Hono, jose, auth/config/accounts/edge-access modules and synthetic successful in-memory stores only; no real credentials/data/network.
checks.workload: Fresh and logout-revoked real-issued refresh read/mutation attempts, exact protected state/revision/index effects, successful access/tool/typed-token controls, JSON renewal and role/optional/cryptographic/SDK/operator cases; baseline and exact counts retained.

checks.command: Independent frozen W02.01 code/test/baseline review and K1 rerun with adversarial challenges; inspect actual targeted regression/typecheck evidence and residual/handoff; retain exact commands and verdict in review-v1.md.
checks.runtime: Independent local source and focused Node integration checks with synthetic stores; no deployed/customer/credential operations.
checks.workload: All W02.01 C1-C3 obligations, exact guard, actual config effects and legitimate controls; prior W01 proof preserved and its revalidation explicitly scheduled.

approval.rationale: Standing approved local G0 mandate and explicit continuation. Lead inspected actual shared JWT, issuer/refresh/config and canonical scope; separate Astra worker/reviewer preflights agreed on narrow deny with real mutation/compatibility controls and no human-policy dependency.

handoff.next_action: Reproduce actual refresh read/config mutation, immediately apply narrow guard, independently verify; then revalidate unchanged W01.02 raw boundary against changed shared auth.
